name: Three-Act (short)
description: A compact setup, confrontation and resolution structure for a short story.

beats.title: Hook
beats.note: Open with a moment that makes the reader want to keep reading.

beats.title: Inciting Incident
beats.note: Show the event that disrupts the character's situation and starts the story.

beats.title: Rising Complications
beats.note: Escalate the problem so each attempt to solve it raises the cost.

beats.title: Climax
beats.note: Bring the central conflict to its decisive moment.

beats.title: Resolution
beats.note: Show what has changed for the character now that the conflict is settled.
